package lintlib

type @ExpressionNode@ = *expressionStub
type @DataDefinition@ = *definitionStub
type @Table@ = *tableStub
type @View@ = *viewStub
type @AbstractType@ interface{}
type @StructureType@ = *structureStub
type @Component@ = *componentStub

type expressionStub struct {kind, text string; children *array[any]; first, last @AbstractToken@}
func(n *expressionStub) @get@() any {return kindStub{n.kind}}
func(n *expressionStub) @concatTokens@() jsString {return str(n.text)}
func(n *expressionStub) @getChildren@() *array[any] {return n.children}
func(n *expressionStub) @getFirstToken@() @AbstractToken@ {return n.first}
func(n *expressionStub) @getLastToken@() @AbstractToken@ {return n.last}
type kindStub struct {name string}
func(k kindStub) descriptor() *classDescriptor {return &classDescriptor{Name:str(k.name)}}
type tokenStub struct {text string; start, end *positionStub}
func(n *tokenStub) @getStr@() jsString {return str(n.text)}
func(n *tokenStub) @getStart@() @Position@ {return n.start}
func(n *tokenStub) @getEnd@() @Position@ {return n.end}
// Deliberately not ExpressionNode, despite carrying token text and positions.
type tokenNodeStub struct {token *tokenStub}
type definitionStub struct {*objectStub; tree @ExpressionNode@; sql optional[jsString]}
func(d *definitionStub) @getTree@() @ExpressionNode@ {return d.tree}
func(d *definitionStub) @getSQLViewName@() optional[jsString] {return d.sql}
type structureStub struct {components *array[any]}
func(s *structureStub) @getComponents@() *array[any] {return s.components}
type componentStub struct {@name@ jsString}
type tableStub struct {*objectStub; parsed @AbstractType@; keys *array[jsString]; seen @Registry@}
func(o *tableStub) @parseType@(r @Registry@, a,b optional[jsString]) @AbstractType@ {if a.Has||b.Has{panic("parseType options must be undefined")};o.seen=r;return o.parsed}
func(o *tableStub) @listKeys@(r @Registry@) *array[jsString] {if r!=o.seen{panic("TABL registry")};return o.keys}
type viewStub struct {*objectStub; parsed @AbstractType@; keys *array[jsString]}
func(o *viewStub) @parseType@(r @Registry@, a,b optional[jsString]) @AbstractType@ {if r==nil||a.Has||b.Has{panic("VIEW parseType arguments")};return o.parsed}
func(o *viewStub) @listKeys@() *array[jsString] {return o.keys}
